<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Particle Network – 120 cyan particles with connecting lines</title>
  <style>
    html, body {
      height: 100%;
      margin: 0;
      background: #0a0e13;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="c"></canvas>

  <script>
    (function() {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('c');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

      const PARTICLE_COUNT = 120;
      const MAX_DIST = 120; // threshold for connecting lines (CSS pixels)

      let w = window.innerWidth;
      let h = window.innerHeight;
      let DPR = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);

      let particles = [];

      function resizeCanvas() {
        DPR = Math.max(1, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
        w = window.innerWidth;
        h = window.innerHeight;

        canvas.style.width = w + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = h + 'px';
        canvas.width = Math.floor(w * DPR);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(h * DPR);

        // Reset transform so drawing uses CSS pixels
        ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        ctx.scale(DPR, DPR);

        // Re-position particles within new bounds (optional)
        for (let p of particles) {
          p.x = Math.min(Math.max(p.x, 0), w);
          p.y = Math.min(Math.max(p.y, 0), h);
        }
      }

      function initParticles() {
        particles.length = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < PARTICLE_COUNT; i++) {
          particles.push({
            x: Math.random() * w,
            y: Math.random() * h,
            vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.25,
            vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.25
          });
        }
      }

      function update() {
        for (let p of particles) {
          // Slow, organic drift with tiny random jitter
          p.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02;
          p.vy += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02;

          // Clamp speed to keep movement gentle
          const maxV = 0.6;
          if (p.vx > maxV) p.vx = maxV;
          if (p.vx < -maxV) p.vx = -maxV;
          if (p.vy > maxV) p.vy = maxV;
          if (p.vy < -maxV) p.vy = -maxV;

          p.x += p.vx;
          p.y += p.vy;

          // Bounce off edges
          if (p.x < 0) { p.x = 0; p.vx *= -1; }
          if (p.x > w) { p.x = w; p.vx *= -1; }
          if (p.y < 0) { p.y = 0; p.vy *= -1; }
          if (p.y > h) { p.y = h; p.vy *= -1; }
        }
      }

      function draw() {
        // Clear with dark background
        ctx.fillStyle = '#0a0e13';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

        // Draw connecting lines (based on proximity)
        ctx.lineWidth = 0.8;
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
        for (let i = 0; i < particles.length; i++) {
          const a = particles[i];
          for (let j = i + 1; j < particles.length; j++) {
            const b = particles[j];
            const dx = b.x - a.x;
            const dy = b.y - a.y;
            const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
            if (dist < MAX_DIST) {
              const alpha = 1 - dist / MAX_DIST;
              ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,' + alpha + ')';
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.moveTo(a.x, a.y);
              ctx.lineTo(b.x, b.y);
              ctx.stroke();
            }
          }
        }

        // Draw particles
        const r = 2.3;
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,1)';
        for (const p of particles) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        }
      }

      function loop() {
        update();
        draw();
        requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }

      window.addEventListener('resize', resizeCanvas, { passive: true });

      resizeCanvas();
      initParticles();
      loop();
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

    <style>
        body, html {

            background-color: #000;
        }

            display: block;

<body>
    <canvas id="canvas"></canvas>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.4.0/p5.js"></script>
    <script>
        let particles = [];
        const MAX_PARTICLES = 120;
        const MIN_DISTANCE = 120;

        let distance = 0;

        function setup() {
            canvas = createCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);
            canvas.parent('canvas');
            for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
                particles.push({
                    x: random(width),
                    y: random(height),
                    size: random(1, 5),
                    color: color(0, 200, 255),
                    speedX: random(-2, 2),
                    speedY: random(-2, 2)
                });
            }
        }

        function draw() {
            background(0);
            let totalDistance = 0;

            for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
                particles[i].x += particles[i].speedX;
                particles[i].y += particles[i].speedY;

                if (particles[i].x > width || particles[i].x < 0) particles[i].speedX *= -1;
                if (particles[i].y > height || particles[i].y < 0) particles[i].speedY *= -1;

                for (let j = i + 1; j < MAX_PARTICLES; j++) {
                    let t = dist(particles[i].x, particles[i].y, particles[j].x, particles[j].y);

                    if (t < MIN_DISTANCE) {
                        totalDistance += t;
                        stroke(cyan, 100, 100);
                        line(particles[i].x, particles[i].y, particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (totalDistance > 0) {
                distance = totalDistance / MAX_PARTICLES;
            }

            drawLines(distance);
        }

        function drawLines(d) {
            let alpha = map(d, 0, MIN_DISTANCE, 255, 0);
            stroke(cyan, 255 - alpha, 255 - alpha);
            noFill();
            for (let i = 0; i < MAX_PARTICLES; i++) {
                for (let j = i + 1; j < MAX_PARTICLES; j++) {
                    let t = dist(particles[i].x, particles[i].y, particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
                    if (t < MIN_DISTANCE) {
                        line(particles[i].x, particles[i].y, particles[j].x, particles[j].y);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        function windowResized() {
            resizeCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);
        }

        function windowResized() {
            resizeCanvas(windowWidth, windowHeight);
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>Code Rain</title>
  <style>
    html, body {
      margin: 0;
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #000;
    }
    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
      background: #000;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="rain"></canvas>
  <script>
    (function () {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('rain');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

      let width = 0;
      let height = 0;
      let dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
      let columns = [];
      let fontSize = 20;
      let chars = [];
      let columnCount = 0;

      const glyphSet = 'アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソタチツテトナニヌネノハヒフヘホマミムメモヤユヨラリルレロワヲン0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ@#$%&*+-<>/=|:;';

      function buildChars() {
        chars = glyphSet.split('');
      }

      function rand(min, max) {
        return Math.random() * (max - min) + min;
      }

      function pickChar() {
        return chars[(Math.random() * chars.length) | 0];
      }

      function resize() {
        dpr = Math.max(1, Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2));
        width = window.innerWidth;
        height = window.innerHeight;
        canvas.width = Math.floor(width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.floor(height * dpr);
        canvas.style.width = width + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = height + 'px';
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);
        ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
        ctx.font = fontSize + 'px monospace';
        columnCount = Math.ceil(width / fontSize);
        columns = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < columnCount; i++) {
          columns.push({
            x: i * fontSize,
            y: rand(-height, 0),
            speed: rand(3, 10),
            length: (rand(8, 28)) | 0,
            chars: Array.from({ length: 40 }, pickChar),
            changeRate: rand(0.02, 0.12),
            glow: rand(0.7, 1)
          });
        }
        ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
      }

      function updateColumn(col) {
        col.y += col.speed;
        if (Math.random() < col.changeRate) {
          const idx = (Math.random() * col.chars.length) | 0;
          col.chars[idx] = pickChar();
        }
        if (col.y - col.length * fontSize > height + rand(0, 200)) {
          col.y = rand(-height * 0.5, -fontSize * 5);
          col.speed = rand(3, 10);
          col.length = (rand(8, 28)) | 0;
          col.changeRate = rand(0.02, 0.12);
          col.glow = rand(0.7, 1);
          col.chars = Array.from({ length: Math.max(40, col.length + 10) }, pickChar);
        }
      }

      function draw() {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.12)';
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

        ctx.font = fontSize + 'px monospace';

        for (let i = 0; i < columns.length; i++) {
          const col = columns[i];
          updateColumn(col);

          for (let j = 0; j < col.length; j++) {
            const y = col.y - j * fontSize;
            if (y < -fontSize || y > height + fontSize) continue;

            const ch = col.chars[j % col.chars.length];
            const t = 1 - j / col.length;

            if (j === 0) {
              ctx.shadowBlur = 12 * col.glow;
              ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(180,255,180,0.9)';
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(210,255,210,0.98)';
            } else {
              const alpha = 0.08 + t * 0.75;
              const green = Math.floor(120 + t * 135);
              ctx.shadowBlur = 6 * t * col.glow;
              ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,255,120,' + (0.25 * t).toFixed(3) + ')';
              ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,' + green + ',70,' + alpha.toFixed(3) + ')';
            }

            ctx.fillText(ch, col.x, y);
          }
        }

        ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
        requestAnimationFrame(draw);
      }

      buildChars();
      resize();
      window.addEventListener('resize', resize);
      requestAnimationFrame(draw);
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Matrix Code Rain</title>
    <style>
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        body {
            background: #000;
            font-family: 'Courier New', monospace;
            height: 100vh;
        }

            display: block;
            background: #000;
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="matrix"></canvas>
    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('matrix');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

        let w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
        let h = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;

        const chars = 'アイウエオカキクケコサシスセソタチツテトナニヌネノハヒフヘホマミムメモヤユヨラリルレロワヲン0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ';
        const fontSize = 14;
        const columns = Math.floor(w / fontSize);
        const drops = Array(columns).fill(1);

        function resize() {
            w = canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
            h = canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', resize);

        function draw() {
            // Fade effect
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

            ctx.font = `${fontSize}px monospace`;

            for (let i = 0; i < drops.length; i++) {
                const text = chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)];
                const x = i * fontSize;
                const y = drops[i] * fontSize;

                // Leading character (bright green)
                ctx.fillStyle = `hsl(120, 100%, ${50 + Math.random() * 20}%)`;
                ctx.fillText(text, x, y);

                // Motion blur trail (fading green)
                for (let j = 0; j < 10 && y - j * fontSize > 0; j++) {
                    const fadeAlpha = 0.3 - (j * 0.03);
                    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(0, 255, 0, ${fadeAlpha})`;
                    ctx.fillText(text, x, y - j * fontSize);
                }

                // Reset drop if it reaches bottom or beyond
                if (y > h && Math.random() > 0.975) {
                    drops[i] = 0;
                }
                drops[i]++;
            }
        }

        function loop() {
            draw();
            requestAnimationFrame(loop);
        }

        loop();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Audio Waveform Visualizer</title>
    <style>
        body {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            background: #0a0a0a;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            min-height: 100vh;
            font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
            overflow: hidden;
        }
        canvas {
            display: block;
            border-radius: 20px;
            box-shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <canvas id="waveform" width="800" height="400"></canvas>

    <script>
        const canvas = document.getElementById('waveform');
        const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
        const width = canvas.width;
        const height = canvas.height;
        const barCount = 64;
        const barWidth = width / barCount;
        const centerY = height * 0.4;

        let time = 0;
        const frequencies = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < barCount; i++) {
            frequencies.push((i + 1) * 0.1);
        }

        function getGradientColor(heightPercent) {
            const hue = (1 - heightPercent) * 240 + 120 * heightPercent;
            const saturation = 90 + 10 * heightPercent;
            const lightness = 50 + 25 * heightPercent;
            return `hsl(${hue}, ${saturation}%, ${lightness}%)`;
        }

        function drawBar(x, height, glowIntensity = 1) {
            const barHeight = Math.max(1, height * centerY);
            const topY = centerY - barHeight;
            const bottomY = centerY + barHeight * 0.3; // Reflection height

            // Main bar gradient
            const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, topY, x, centerY);
            gradient.addColorStop(0, getGradientColor(1));
            gradient.addColorStop(0.3, getGradientColor(0.7));
            gradient.addColorStop(0.7, getGradientColor(0.3));
            gradient.addColorStop(1, getGradientColor(0));

            ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
            ctx.fillRect(x - barWidth/2 + 1, topY, barWidth - 2, barHeight);

            // Glow effect
            ctx.shadowColor = getGradientColor(1);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 15 * glowIntensity;
            ctx.fillRect(x - barWidth/2 + 1, topY, barWidth - 2, barHeight * 0.3);
            ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

            // Reflection
            const reflectionGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(x, centerY, x, bottomY);
            reflectionGradient.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)');
            reflectionGradient.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(255,255,255,0.05)');
            reflectionGradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,255,0)');

            ctx.fillStyle = reflectionGradient;
            ctx.fillRect(x - barWidth/2 + 1, centerY, barWidth - 2, barHeight * 0.3);
        }

        function animate() {
            ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10, 10, 10, 0.15)';
            ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

            // Subtle grid lines
            ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)';
            ctx.lineWidth = 1;
            for (let y = 0; y < height; y += 40) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(0, y);
                ctx.lineTo(width, y);
                ctx.stroke();
            }

            time += 0.03;

            for (let i = 0; i < barCount; i++) {
                const x = (i + 0.5) * barWidth;
                
                // Multi-layered sine waves for realistic audio feel
                let amplitude = 0;
                amplitude += Math.sin(time * frequencies[i] + i * 0.5) * 0.4;
                amplitude += Math.sin(time * frequencies[i] * 1.3 + i * 0.3) * 0.25;
                amplitude += Math.sin(time * frequencies[i] * 0.7 + i * 0.8) * 0.15;
                amplitude += Math.sin(time * frequencies[i] * 2.1 - i * 0.2) * 0.1;
                
                // Peak detection for extra pop
                const peak = Math.sin(time * 8 + i * 0.2) * 0.3;
                amplitude = Math.max(amplitude + peak * 0.2, 0);

                const glowIntensity = 1 + Math.sin(time * 5 + i * 0.1) * 0.3;
                drawBar(x, amplitude, glowIntensity);
            }

            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }

        animate();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

<html>
<head>
<style>
  body { font-family: monospace; }
  #canvas { border: 1px solid black; }
  #canvas2 { border: 1px solid black; }
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="canvas" width="400" height="400"></canvas>
<canvas id="canvas2" width="400" height="400"></canvas>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.4.4/dist/d3.min.js"></script>
<script>
  let arr = Array(40).fill(0).map(() => Math.random() * 400);
  let arr2 = arr.slice();
  let canvas = document.getElementById('canvas');
  let ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let canvas2 = document.getElementById('canvas2');
  let ctx2 = canvas2.getContext('2d');
  let comparing = [-1, -1];
  let comparing2 = [-1, -1];

  function draw(arr, ctx, comparing) {
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0, 400, 400);
    let barWidth = 400 / arr.length;
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
      if (comparing[0] == i || comparing[1] == i) {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
      } else {
        ctx.fillStyle = 'blue';
      }
      ctx.fillRect(i * barWidth, 400 - arr[i], barWidth, arr[i]);
    }
  }

  function bubbleSort(arr, ctx, comparing) {
    for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
      for (let j = 0; j < arr.length - i - 1; j++) {
        comparing[0] = j;
        comparing[1] = j + 1;
        draw(arr, ctx, comparing);
        if (arr[j] > arr[j + 1]) {
          let temp = arr[j];
          arr[j] = arr[j + 1];
          arr[j + 1] = temp;
        }
        setTimeout(() => {}, 10);
      }
    }
    comparing[0] = -1;
    comparing[1] = -1;
    draw(arr, ctx, comparing);
    return arr;
  }

  function quickSort(arr, ctx, comparing, low, high) {
    if (low < high) {
      let pi = partition(arr, ctx, comparing, low, high);
      quickSort(arr, ctx, comparing, low, pi - 1);
      quickSort(arr, ctx, comparing, pi + 1, high);
    }
    return arr;
  }

  function partition(arr, ctx, comparing, low, high) {
    let pivot = arr[high];
    let i = low - 1;
    for (let j = low; j < high; j++) {
      comparing[0] = j;
      comparing[1] = high;
      draw(arr, ctx, comparing);
      if (arr[j] < pivot) {
        i++;
        let temp = arr[i];
        arr[i] = arr[j];
        arr[j] = temp;
      }
      setTimeout(() => {}, 10);
    }
    let temp = arr[i + 1];
    arr[i + 1] = arr[high];
    arr[high] = temp;
    comparing[0] = -1;
    comparing[1] = -1;
    draw(arr, ctx, comparing);
    return i + 1;
  }

  function start() {
    arr = Array(40).fill(0).map(() => Math.random() * 400);
    arr2 = arr.slice();
    comparing[0] = -1;
    comparing[1] = -1;
    comparing2[0] = -1;
    comparing2[1] = -1;
    draw(arr, ctx, comparing);
    draw(arr2, ctx2, comparing2);
    bubbleSort(arr, ctx, comparing);
    quickSort(arr2, ctx2, comparing2, 0, arr2.length - 1);
    setTimeout(start, 2000);
  }

  start();
</script>
</body>
</html>
